name: Fire station
description: Fire station, 26 x 18 m: a 16 x 18 m brick apparatus bay with three tall sectional doors on the front (the centre one open, a fire engine placed behind it as a companion), a drive-through door at the back, clerestory glazing, gear lockers, hose racks and lane markings; a two-storey wing with the office and watch room, a gear store and toilets below and a day room, kitchen, dormitory and washroom above off a stair; and a three-storey concrete drill tower with open window openings, an internal stair and a parapeted roof on the back corner.
